user.title: Aimo Park
user.description: Enter either a refresh token by itself, or both your Aimo Park e-mail and password. Leave Pool ID empty to include all pools your account can use.

data.username: Aimo Park e-mail (optional when using a refresh token)
data.password: Password (optional when using a refresh token)
data.refresh_token: Refresh token (optional if e-mail and password are provided)
data.pool_id: Pool ID (optional, limits to one pool)

reauth.title: Re-authenticate Aimo Park
reauth.description: Enter either your Aimo Park e-mail and password, or a refresh token.

error.ttl_min_gte_max: Minimum TTL must be less than maximum TTL.
error.auth_method_required: Enter a refresh token or both an e-mail and password.
error.auth_method_incomplete: Enter both an e-mail and password, or use a refresh token.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Aimo Park login server. Check your network connection and try again.

init.title: Polling windows & cache
init.description: Adjust the time windows for busy/normal polling and cache lifetimes. Times are in 24-hour HH:MM format (Helsinki timezone, weekdays only).

error.ttl_min_gte_max: Minimum TTL must be less than maximum TTL.
